mentions.name: Attached
mentions.description: This app helps users prevent spirals, positioning itself against ChatGPT which validates spirals instead of stopping them. Version 2 is in development based on learnings since launching about a year ago.
mentions.problem: ChatGPT validates users' spirals rather than helping prevent them.
mentions.audience: ChatGPT users who turn to it during spirals; implied individual consumers seeking emotional support.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Continuing to work on https://attachedapp.com.

ChatGPT validates your spirals. We help you prevent them.

We're in the middle of v2 over the next few months based on everything we've learned since launching ~a year ago.
